Counting logic & source quality

Rows are title records; no source rows are deleted or filled. Countries and genres are comma-separated, trimmed and deduplicated within each title. A co-production counts once under each country, so category totals may exceed total titles. Missing countries do not count toward distinct countries. Missing ratings remain an explicit category. Filters combine using AND. Hover over chart marks for counts.

Dates are grouped monthly; gaps within the represented date range are filled with zero counts. The timeline describes recorded additions only. Stacked release-year comparisons show the latest 15 represented years. Country spellings and factual metadata were not externally verified.
